ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels in the central lobe regions and 25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at margins and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit contiguous high-intensity white pigmentation. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and dense clusters at the distal tips. Interstitial mottling is present at the pigmentation transitions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated vertex angle of 70-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the trailing edge boundary of both lobes, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetry with an outward convex sweep along the trailing edges tapering to acute points at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark pixel clusters consistent with barnacle-related scarring visible on the distal ends of both lobes, particularly prominent on the leftmost tip area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) on the distal portion of the right lobe; isolated dark linear streak on the mid-distal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake marks on the right fluke lobe; irregular indentation/trauma on the right-most trailing edge tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific grouping of three parallel linear scars on the right fluke distal quadrant.
